svg.text: V2X ECU call flow, 2 of 3 — reception and decoding
The pipeline runs synchronously on the receive thread. Ten messages per second require no queue.
message content, or a decode error
on error: reject, count, log — the process never fails
validate against the profile ranges; reject and count violations
Ten deliberately malformed messages are exercised against this path in the test
suite: six are rejected and four are tolerated exactly as the profile requires.
